name: Pipeliners - 404 Audit 2026-09-24
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-09-24

# Summary
A one-file audit (`404-audit.csv`, 30 URLs) of every known 404 on pipelinersusa.com as of Sep 24, 2026, with live status, where each URL is linked from, sitemap presence, outside links (Site Explorer), Search Atlas incoming links, and a recommendation.

# Key findings
- Most 404s were linked only from the hidden OTTO dynamic-indexing block on the homepage, not from any visible page.
- Groups: old category addresses missing /category/ (/pipe-repair/, /pipeliners/, /root-intrusion/, /plumbing-tips/, /plumbing-upgrades/, /clogged-drain/), past-the-end archive pages (correct behavior), deleted bulk-import blog posts, an old blog address, /reviews/, /service-areas/ (never existed; real hub is /services-areas/), an old author address and /quote/.
- No URL had outside links pointing at it (Site Explorer 0 for all).

# Decisions and status
- Redirect proposed for 8: /service-areas/ to /services-areas/ (Kim decides, the hub took pMax impressions), the six old category roots to their /category/ archives, and /signs-of-outdated-sewer-and-drain-pipes/ to /signs-of-outdated-sewer-drain-pipes/.
- Leave as 404: archive pagination past the end, old author page, /pipeline-environmental-compliance-arizona/, /quote/ (do not point it at the estimate page, which is an Ads landing page).
- Kim to choose: 4 deleted posts with no old-slug record. Redirect only if a live post covers the same topic, and check Ads first.
- Follow-up: the Sep 30 technical errors audit confirmed 29 of 30 still 404 with zero live links; the 8 redirects were still proposed.
